title: The Legend of the Mngwa

scenes.narration: Massive paw prints outside the heavy wooden door left the terrified villagers certain that something impossible was prowling.
Back in nineteen thirty-eight in Tanganyika, terrified local residents whispered quietly about the dreaded Mngwa.
The unseen beast was described as far more ferocious than any lion and much faster than a leopard.
Some frightened residents even believed it walked as a human by day before shifting forms at night.
British administrator William Hitchens finally arrived to track down the true source of the terror.
As local residents detailed the nightly attacks, Hitchens carefully searched for physical evidence.
Instead of finding any shapeshifter, he ultimately concluded the culprit was simply a lion with gigantism.
No actual body was ever found, leaving you to decide if giant tracks mean a hidden beast.
